description.en: A dirt path leading all the way up to a stranded, crumbled village.
description.zh-hans: 泥土路的尽头是一座衰败、而又破碎的村庄。
description.zh-hant: 泥土路的盡頭是一座衰敗、而又破碎的村莊。

description.en: Wind chimes rattle in the wind across the ruined streets, witnessing this slaughter in the name of the Divine.
description.zh-hans: 狼藉的街道上风铃随风作响，见证着这场以神之名的屠杀。
description.zh-hant: 狼藉的街道上風鈴隨風作響，見證著這場以神之名的屠殺。

description.en: The instigators praise the name of the Divine, acting without restraint in broad daylight.
description.zh-hans: 始作俑者正在歌颂着神祇的名讳，在光天化日下肆意妄为。
description.zh-hant: 始作俑者正在歌頌著神祇的名諱，在光天化日下肆意妄為。
